evidence.sourceTitle: FlowBench (Counterfactual Spatial Imagination) official release documentation

evidence.statement: Each simulation sample includes a before/after pair for an explicit object move, state-derived answers and optical flow/depth/masks. The release includes data construction and evaluation procedures, making the physical counterfactual target identifiable.
